headerDisplay: GivHome connects Homebridge to compatible GivEnergy systems over your local network. GivTCP is not required for v4 local control.

name.title: HomeKit name
name.description: Display name used for the bridge/accessories.

inverterHost.title: Inverter IP address
inverterHost.description: Required. Local IP address of the GivEnergy inverter/adapter on port 8899. GivTCP is not required.

inverterPort.title: Inverter port
inverterPort.description: Leave at 8899 for normal GivEnergy local Modbus. Advanced adapter validation only.

inverterSerial.title: Inverter serial
inverterSerial.description: Required. Safety gate: the plugin rejects a responder if the serial does not match this value.

maxPvKw.title: Maximum Solar Power (kW)
maxPvKw.description: Optional. Used only to scale the Solar Generating Lightbulb brightness. Example: enter 2.8 for a 2.8 kW array. Set 0 if there is no PV or if you do not want percentage scaling yet.

enableReadOnlyPolling.title: Enable telemetry polling
enableReadOnlyPolling.description: Recommended. Reads IR0-60 for HomeKit telemetry only.

staleAfterConsecutiveFailures.title: Failures before telemetry marked stale
staleAfterConsecutiveFailures.description: Short single failures keep the last good telemetry; repeated failures mark active-state accessories inactive.

enableReadOnlyCapabilityDiscovery.title: Run read-only capability discovery at startup
enableReadOnlyCapabilityDiscovery.description: Optional. Reads evidence banks only; no writes, no command exposure. Useful while validating a new inverter family.

capabilityDiscoveryLevel.title: Capability discovery level
capabilityDiscoveryLevel.description: Core reads the banks needed for identity and validated CH/AIO schedule evidence. Extended/opportunity scans more advisory banks and may take longer.

enableStage4SafetyFrameworkReadback.title: Log safety framework readback
enableStage4SafetyFrameworkReadback.description: Logs the preserve/readback/restore planning summary after capability discovery. No writes.

advancedDiagnostics.title: Advanced diagnostics logging
advancedDiagnostics.description: Verbose transport and telemetry diagnostics. Leave off for normal use.

enableManualChargeCommandAccessory.title: Expose Manual Charge command accessory
enableManualChargeCommandAccessory.description: Advanced safety gate. Leave off for normal use. Exposes the Manual Charge command accessory only when explicitly enabled.

manualChargeCommandAccessoryAcknowledgem.title: Manual Charge accessory acknowledgement
manualChargeCommandAccessoryAcknowledgem.description: Advanced confirmation value. Leave blank for normal safe operation.

enableManualChargeHomeKitLiveWrites.title: Enable Manual Charge HomeKit live writes
enableManualChargeHomeKitLiveWrites.description: Advanced safety gate. Leave off for normal use. Enables live HomeKit writes only when all required safety gates are explicitly enabled.

manualChargeHomeKitLiveWriteAcknowledgem.title: Manual Charge live-write acknowledgement
manualChargeHomeKitLiveWriteAcknowledgem.description: Advanced confirmation value. Leave blank for normal safe operation.

manualChargeCommandDurationMinutes.title: Manual Charge command duration (minutes)
manualChargeCommandDurationMinutes.description: Used only when the advanced Manual Charge command accessory and live-write gates are both enabled.

manualChargeExpiredSlotFailsafeGate.title: Enable expired manual-charge failsafe
manualChargeExpiredSlotFailsafeGate.description: Allows GivHome to turn off a stale manual-charge enable after its active window has expired. Normal users can leave this enabled.

manualChargeExpiredSlotFailsafeAcknowled.title: Expired Manual Charge failsafe acknowledgement
manualChargeExpiredSlotFailsafeAcknowled.description: Advanced confirmation value for the expired Manual Charge failsafe.

manualChargeExpiredSlotFailsafePollSecon.title: Expired Manual Charge supervisor interval (seconds)
manualChargeExpiredSlotFailsafePollSecon.description: How often the monitor-only supervisor checks the Manual Charge registers.

manualChargeExpiredSlotFailsafeGraceMinu.title: Expired Manual Charge grace period (minutes)
manualChargeExpiredSlotFailsafeGraceMinu.description: Grace period after the Manual Charge end time before a repair would be eligible if the third gate is enabled.

targetSoc.title: Target battery charge %
targetSoc.description: Target battery level used for Cheap Overnight, Intelligent Octopus Go smart-slot home-battery protection and Charge tiles.

enableTimedChargeTiles.title: Enable Charge 30/60/90/120 tiles
enableTimedChargeTiles.description: Shows Charge 30, 60, 90 and 120 minute switches in Apple Home. GivHome uses direct local readback before, during and after each command.

enableTimedExportTiles.title: Enable Export 30/60/90/120 tiles
enableTimedExportTiles.description: Shows Export 30, 60, 90 and 120 minute switches in Apple Home. GivHome uses the proven local export route for your inverter model and verifies command readback.

enablePauseTiles.title: Enable Pause Charge/Discharge/Both tiles
enablePauseTiles.description: Shows Pause Charge, Pause Discharge and Pause Both switches in Apple Home. These are simple On/Off switches: On sets the selected pause mode, Off returns the battery to Eco. Apple Home automations can provide any timing you want.

manualExportTargetSoc.title: Manual export lower battery target %
manualExportTargetSoc.description: Target/reserve SOC used by direct Modbus Export tiles. Higher values are more cautious. Default is 30%.

manualExportPowerPercent.title: Legacy manual export power %
manualExportPowerPercent.description: Legacy HR112 percentage retained for existing config.json compatibility. New installs should use Timed Export power (kW).

octopusApiKey.title: Octopus Energy API key
octopusApiKey.description: Used only when Intelligent Octopus Go smart windows are enabled. GivHome calls Octopus plannedDispatches directly; GivTCP is not used.

octopusAccountNumber.title: Octopus Energy account number
octopusAccountNumber.description: Usually starts with A-. Used with the Octopus Energy API key to read Intelligent Octopus Go planned dispatch windows.

enableOctopusSmartWindows.title: Enable Intelligent Octopus Go smart windows
enableOctopusSmartWindows.description: Reads planned dispatch windows from Intelligent Octopus Go. Cheap Overnight does not depend on this; it has its own user-configured schedule.

octopusPollSeconds.title: Octopus polling seconds
octopusPollSeconds.description: How often GivHome may check Intelligent Octopus Go for planned dispatch windows when enabled.

cheapStart.title: Cheap Overnight start time
cheapStart.description: Your normal low-rate period start. Used even without Intelligent Octopus Go.

cheapEnd.title: Cheap Overnight end time
cheapEnd.description: Your normal low-rate period end. GivHome returns the inverter to normal Eco behaviour afterwards.

graceMinutes.title: Smart-window grace minutes
graceMinutes.description: After an Intelligent Octopus Go smart dispatch ends, GivHome may continue home-battery protection to the next half-hour boundary, up to this many minutes. This does not extend Battery Care.

enableEvSmartWindowBatteryProtection.title: Protect home battery during Intelligent Octopus Go smart slots
enableEvSmartWindowBatteryProtection.description: When Intelligent Octopus Go schedules a smart EV charging slot, GivHome can stop the home battery discharging into the car. Choose the method below.

enableBatteryCareCharging.title: Enable Battery Care Charging
enableBatteryCareCharging.description: Optional overnight-only charge-rate planning for the main Cheap Overnight window.

batteryCapacityKwh.title: Battery size used for planning (kWh)
batteryCapacityKwh.description: Used by Battery Care, Evening Excess Export and Octopus Flux Export planning.

maxBatteryChargePowerKw.title: Maximum battery charge power (kW)
maxBatteryChargePowerKw.description: Used to translate Battery Care planning into HR111 charge-rate percentages.

batteryCareMode.title: Battery Care mode
batteryCareMode.description: Controls how cautious the overnight Battery Care charge-rate plan is.

batteryCareMinimumWindowMinutes.title: Minimum overnight time remaining
batteryCareMinimumWindowMinutes.description: Battery Care writes HR111 only when the main overnight cheap window has at least this much time remaining.

enableEveningExcessExport.title: Enable Evening Excess Export
enableEveningExcessExport.description: Optional. Enables GivHome’s evening sell-off planner. Once configured here, use the GivHome Evening Excess Export switch in Apple Home to arm or disarm it day to day. Only enable this if you are paid for export and want GivHome to manage spare evening battery export automatically before the cheap overnight charge window. Legacy v3.7.5 enableExcessEnergyExport is also honoured.

eveningExportStartTime.title: Evening export earliest start
eveningExportStartTime.description: Earliest time Evening Excess Export may begin. Legacy v3.7.5 excessExportStartTime / excessExportStart are also honoured.

eveningExportReserveSoc.title: Minimum battery to keep %
eveningExportReserveSoc.description: Minimum battery level to preserve before the cheap overnight window. Legacy v3.7.5 excessExportReserveSoc is also honoured.

eveningExportSlotMinutes.title: Evening export slot minutes
eveningExportSlotMinutes.description: How long each Evening Excess Export slot should run before GivHome checks the battery and time remaining again. Legacy v3.7.5 excessExportSlotMinutes is also honoured.

eveningExportMarginSoc.title: Evening export safety margin %
eveningExportMarginSoc.description: Extra battery percentage above the calculated reserve required before export may start. Legacy v3.7.5 excessExportMarginSoc is also honoured.

serveOvernightLoadFromBattery.title: Serve overnight load from battery
serveOvernightLoadFromBattery.description: Advanced planning option. Leave off for most Intelligent Octopus Go homes.

enableEveEnergyHistory.title: Enable Eve energy history
enableEveEnergyHistory.description: Creates Solar, Import and Export history collectors and stores local totals. Uses fakegato-history when available.

eveHistorySampleMinutes.title: Eve history sample minutes
eveHistorySampleMinutes.description: Sampling interval for local Eve-style energy history totals.

enableCeAcCoupledLiveWrites.title: Enable CE/AC-coupled live writes
enableCeAcCoupledLiveWrites.description: Additional profile gate. CE/AC-coupled systems use core-window preserve/restore and must not use CH/AIO slot-8 assumptions.

modbusUnitAddress.title: Modbus unit address (engineering override only)
modbusUnitAddress.description: Hidden from the normal form. The plugin uses fixed unit 17 for normal GivEnergy local Modbus unless config.json is manually edited with an explicit engineering override acknowledgement.

enableCheapOvernightCharging.title: Enable Cheap Overnight charging
enableCheapOvernightCharging.description: Uses your normal off-peak window even when Intelligent Octopus Go is not configured or has not supplied smart charging slots.

eveningExportPowerKw.title: Evening export power limit (kW)
eveningExportPowerKw.description: Requested Evening Excess Export battery discharge power. Uses the same kW-to-HR112 calculation as Timed Export, while keeping a separate value for the planner. Legacy v3.7.5 maxExportPowerKw / excessExportDischargeKw aliases are also honoured.

maxBatteryExportPowerKw.title: Maximum battery export power (kW)
maxBatteryExportPowerKw.description: Battery/inverter discharge capability used to convert export kW into HR112 percentage. Example: 6.0 for an AIO 6kW.

maxGridExportPowerKw.title: Maximum allowed grid export (kW)
maxGridExportPowerKw.description: Site/DNO grid export ceiling used as a safety clamp. GivHome estimates battery export + PV - house load before writing HR112.

timedExportPowerKw.title: Timed Export power (kW)
timedExportPowerKw.description: Requested battery export/discharge power for Export 30/60/90/120. GivHome converts this to HR112 and clamps to the maximum battery export and grid export settings.

iogHomeBatteryProtectionMode.title: Home-battery protection method
iogHomeBatteryProtectionMode.description: Choose how GivHome protects the home battery during Intelligent Octopus Go smart EV charging slots. Restores the previous state afterwards, after the smart slot and any active grace period.

enableApplianceControl.title: Enable appliance controls
enableApplianceControl.description: Hidden safe default used by the product appliance-control engine.

applianceControlAcknowledgement.title: Appliance control acknowledgement
applianceControlAcknowledgement.description: Hidden safe default used by the product appliance-control engine.

enableOctopusFluxExport.title: Show Octopus Flux Export switch
enableOctopusFluxExport.description: Adds one Apple Home switch for Flux peak export. Turn the Apple Home switch on when you want GivHome to sell spare battery during the Flux peak period. GivHome does not try to fill the whole peak band; it plans short slots from the battery energy actually spare after reserve and margin.

octopusFluxDaysToRun.title: Legacy Flux days list
octopusFluxDaysToRun.description: Legacy/internal value retained for existing config.json compatibility. New installs should use Days to export.

octopusFluxExportStartTime.title: Flux eligible peak starts
octopusFluxExportStartTime.description: Advanced. Start of the Flux tariff peak period that is eligible for export. This is not a promise to export from this time; GivHome still calculates how much energy is genuinely spare.

octopusFluxExportEndTime.title: Flux eligible peak ends
octopusFluxExportEndTime.description: Advanced. End of the Flux tariff peak period that is eligible for export. Actual run length is limited by spare kWh, reserve, safety margin, load, PV and export power.

octopusFluxEveningReserveKwh.title: Also keep this energy (kWh)
octopusFluxEveningReserveKwh.description: Advanced. Optional kWh reserve. GivHome keeps whichever is safer: this energy reserve or the battery percentage above.

octopusFluxReserveSoc.title: Keep at least this battery (%)
octopusFluxReserveSoc.description: GivHome stops before the battery falls below this level. Use a higher value if the house needs more evening or overnight energy; this may deliberately shorten the Flux run.

octopusFluxSafetyMarginSoc.title: Start only above reserve by (%)
octopusFluxSafetyMarginSoc.description: Advanced. Extra headroom above the reserve before a Flux export slot may start. A higher margin deliberately shortens or prevents export.

octopusFluxExportPowerKw.title: Maximum export power (kW)
octopusFluxExportPowerKw.description: The most battery power GivHome may request during Flux Export. On CH/AIO scheduled export this HR112 power-ratio value is written and read back, but live planning is budgeted from observed/effective discharge because some firmware exports at full power despite accepting the ratio.

octopusFluxSlotMinutes.title: Maximum run/check slice (minutes)
octopusFluxSlotMinutes.description: Advanced. GivHome exports in short slices and re-checks spare battery, house load and time before continuing. This is not the total Flux run length.

octopusFluxMinimumExportKwh.title: Minimum spare energy (kWh)
octopusFluxMinimumExportKwh.description: Advanced. GivHome will not start if there is less than this spare energy above reserve and margin.

octopusFluxTariffImportPence.title: Legacy Flux reference import cost (p/kWh)
octopusFluxTariffImportPence.description: Legacy evidence value retained for existing config.json compatibility. Not shown in the normal Flux UI.

octopusFluxTariffExportPence.title: Legacy Flux reference export value (p/kWh)
octopusFluxTariffExportPence.description: Legacy evidence value retained for existing config.json compatibility. Not shown in the normal Flux UI.

enableOctopusAgileOutgoingAutoExport.title: Enable Octopus Agile Export
enableOctopusAgileOutgoingAutoExport.description: Optional Agile Export Autopilot. When enabled and armed in Apple Home, GivHome learns local energy behaviour and plans saleable spare energy against any high-value Agile Outgoing half-hour. It is not tied to the Flux 16:00-19:00 peak band.

octopusAgileOutgoingProductCode.title: Agile Outgoing product code
octopusAgileOutgoingProductCode.description: Octopus product code used for Agile Outgoing export prices. Leave as default unless Octopus changes product.

octopusAgileOutgoingRegionCode.title: Agile Outgoing region code
octopusAgileOutgoingRegionCode.description: Your Octopus electricity region letter, A-P. GivHome builds the Agile Outgoing export tariff code from this if no full tariff code is supplied.

octopusAgileOutgoingTariffCode.title: Agile Outgoing full tariff code
octopusAgileOutgoingTariffCode.description: Optional full tariff code, for example E-1R-AGILE-OUTGOING-19-05-13-J. If left blank, GivHome builds it from product and region.

octopusAgileOutgoingAllowedStartTime.title: Custom limiter start time
octopusAgileOutgoingAllowedStartTime.description: Only used when Slot search is Custom time window. Any high-value slot ignores this field completely. Leave blank or 00:00 unless deliberately testing a custom time limit.

octopusAgileOutgoingAllowedEndTime.title: Custom limiter end time
octopusAgileOutgoingAllowedEndTime.description: Only used when Slot search is Custom time window. Any high-value slot ignores this field completely. Leave blank or 23:59 unless deliberately testing a custom time limit.

octopusAgileOutgoingDaysToRun.title: Agile days to run
octopusAgileOutgoingDaysToRun.description: Days on which the armed Agile Outgoing optimiser may start autonomous export. Remove days when you want to keep the battery for known home use, for example a regular high-use evening.

octopusAgileOutgoingMinimumExportPricePe.title: Minimum export price (p/kWh)
octopusAgileOutgoingMinimumExportPricePe.description: GivHome will only consider Agile Outgoing half-hours at or above this price. This is the plain user-facing price hurdle.

octopusAgileOutgoingReferenceImportPence.title: Energy cost baseline (advanced, p/kWh)
octopusAgileOutgoingReferenceImportPence.description: Advanced internal value test. For IOG users this normally represents the cheap-rate energy baseline. It is used with the extra reward setting and does not change Octopus billing. Runtime clamps still apply; leave the default unless deliberately tuning.

octopusAgileOutgoingMinimumGrossMarginPe.title: Minimum extra reward above cheap charge cost (p/kWh)
octopusAgileOutgoingMinimumGrossMarginPe.description: Advanced value guard. Agile export must beat the energy cost baseline by at least this much before GivHome considers selling battery energy. Runtime clamps still apply; leave the default unless deliberately tuning.

octopusAgileOutgoingReserveSoc.title: Minimum battery to keep (%)
octopusAgileOutgoingReserveSoc.description: Minimum battery percentage to keep for the home before autonomous export.

octopusAgileOutgoingEveningReserveKwh.title: Evening energy to keep (kWh)
octopusAgileOutgoingEveningReserveKwh.description: Minimum usable energy to preserve for the home. GivHome keeps whichever is larger: this kWh reserve or the percentage reserve. Runtime clamps still apply; leave the default unless deliberately tuning.

octopusAgileOutgoingSafetyMarginSoc.title: Agile safety margin (%)
octopusAgileOutgoingSafetyMarginSoc.description: Extra battery percentage above the reserve required before autonomous export may start. Runtime clamps still apply; leave the default unless deliberately tuning.

octopusAgileOutgoingExportPowerKw.title: Maximum export power (kW)
octopusAgileOutgoingExportPowerKw.description: Maximum battery export/discharge power GivHome may request during Agile Export. Live decisions are still clamped against battery limit, PV, load and grid export limit.

octopusAgileOutgoingMinimumExportKwh.title: Minimum spare energy to export (kWh)
octopusAgileOutgoingMinimumExportKwh.description: GivHome will not start an Agile export slot unless spare energy above reserve and margin is at least this amount. Runtime clamps still apply; leave the default unless deliberately tuning.

octopusAgileOutgoingDailyExportCapKwh.title: Maximum to sell per day (kWh)
octopusAgileOutgoingDailyExportCapKwh.description: Maximum planned/observed export energy GivHome may sell per local day. In Auto mode this acts as an upper cap; in Custom mode it is the direct daily cap.

octopusAgileOutgoingDryRun.title: Agile planner only / dry run
octopusAgileOutgoingDryRun.description: Leave on for first testing. GivHome fetches prices, learns and logs plans, but does not write export registers until dry run is off, the execution stage permits it, and the live acknowledgement is set.

octopusAgileOutgoingLiveAcknowledgement.title: Agile live export acknowledgement
octopusAgileOutgoingLiveAcknowledgement.description: To allow unattended live Agile Export, set this exactly to ENABLE_AGILE_OUTGOING_LIVE_EXPORT, turn dry run off, and choose a live execution stage.

octopusAgileOutgoingEnableMpanAudit.title: Check results against export MPAN
octopusAgileOutgoingEnableMpanAudit.description: Optional delayed audit. Uses your Octopus API key, export MPAN and export meter serial to compare planned/inverter export against Octopus export-metered kWh.

octopusExportMpan.title: Export MPAN
octopusExportMpan.description: Your export MPAN. Used only for Agile Outgoing MPAN audit, not for live safety decisions.

octopusExportMeterSerial.title: Export meter serial number
octopusExportMeterSerial.description: Meter serial paired with the export MPAN. Used only for Agile Outgoing MPAN audit.

octopusAgileOutgoingMpanAuditDelayHours.title: MPAN audit delay (hours)
octopusAgileOutgoingMpanAuditDelayHours.description: How long after an export slot ends before checking Octopus export MPAN data. Octopus data is delayed, so this is not used as a live safety signal. Runtime clamps still apply; leave the default unless deliberately tuning.

octopusAgileOutgoingMpanMismatchToleranc.title: MPAN mismatch tolerance (kWh)
octopusAgileOutgoingMpanMismatchToleranc.description: Allowed difference between inverter-observed export and Octopus export MPAN kWh before the audit is considered a mismatch. Runtime clamps still apply; leave the default unless deliberately tuning.

octopusAgileOutgoingSuspendOnMpanMismatc.title: Suspend on MPAN mismatch
octopusAgileOutgoingSuspendOnMpanMismatc.description: If enabled, GivHome disarms Agile Outgoing Auto Export after a significant MPAN mismatch.

octopusFluxRunDaysPreset.title: Days to export
octopusFluxRunDaysPreset.description: Choose the days when GivHome is allowed to start Flux Export. For example, exclude a regular high-use day when you want to keep more battery at home.

octopusFluxRunMonday.title: Run on Monday
octopusFluxRunMonday.description: Used only when Days to export is set to Custom day checkboxes below.

octopusFluxRunTuesday.title: Run on Tuesday
octopusFluxRunTuesday.description: Used only when Days to export is set to Custom day checkboxes below.

octopusFluxRunWednesday.title: Run on Wednesday
octopusFluxRunWednesday.description: Used only when Days to export is set to Custom day checkboxes below.

octopusFluxRunThursday.title: Run on Thursday
octopusFluxRunThursday.description: Used only when Days to export is set to Custom day checkboxes below.

octopusFluxRunFriday.title: Run on Friday
octopusFluxRunFriday.description: Used only when Days to export is set to Custom day checkboxes below.

octopusFluxRunSaturday.title: Run on Saturday
octopusFluxRunSaturday.description: Used only when Days to export is set to Custom day checkboxes below.

octopusFluxRunSunday.title: Run on Sunday
octopusFluxRunSunday.description: Used only when Days to export is set to Custom day checkboxes below.

octopusAgileOutgoingExecutionStage.title: Execution stage
octopusAgileOutgoingExecutionStage.description: Staged live gate. Planner only is safest and performs no inverter writes. Single-slot proves one slot. Multi-slot can trade more than one selected half-hour. Adaptive also uses learning evidence for saleable-energy and headroom decisions.

octopusAgileOutgoingStrategy.title: Strategy
octopusAgileOutgoingStrategy.description: Controls how much of the learned saleable-energy budget GivHome is allowed to commit. Maximum return can use many profitable half-hour slots; extra cautious keeps wider reserve margins.

octopusAgileOutgoingLearningMode.title: Learning mode
octopusAgileOutgoingLearningMode.description: Observe only records local PV, load, SOC and export-response patterns for evidence. Adaptive allows those learned patterns to influence saleable-energy and export-headroom planning.

octopusAgileOutgoingDailyExportMode.title: Daily sell limit mode
octopusAgileOutgoingDailyExportMode.description: Auto estimates how many kWh are safe to sell from SOC, reserve, PV/load evidence and learned local behaviour. Custom uses the maximum-to-sell setting directly.
enumNames: Auto — learn how much is spare

octopusAgileOutgoingRunDaysPreset.title: Days to export
octopusAgileOutgoingRunDaysPreset.description: Simple days-to-export choice. Use Custom to reveal individual day checkboxes in the advanced section.

octopusAgileOutgoingSlotSearchMode.title: Slot search
octopusAgileOutgoingSlotSearchMode.description: Default is Any high-value slot. GivHome searches every published Agile Outgoing half-hour that passes reserve, price and conflict checks. Custom time window is an optional limiter and should normally be left unused.

schema.description: Configure local GivEnergy monitoring and optional HomeKit controls for GivHome Modbus.

form.title: Octopus Agile Outgoing Auto Export
form.description: Autonomous sell/export optimiser. The Apple Home switch arms the optimiser; live inverter writes require dry-run off and the live acknowledgement. MPAN audit is delayed evidence, not live protection.

form.title: GivHome Setup
form.description: Required local details and planning limits. GivTCP is not required.

form.title: Cheap Overnight
form.description: Your normal low-rate period. This works even if you are not on Intelligent Octopus Go and even when no smart dispatches are supplied.

form.title: Intelligent Octopus Go
form.description: Optional Intelligent Octopus Go planned-dispatch polling. When a smart EV charging slot is scheduled, GivHome can protect the home battery from discharging into the car, then restore the previous state afterwards.

form.title: Battery Care Charging
form.description: Optional charge-rate planning for the main Cheap Overnight window only. It does not apply to extra smart dispatches, grace periods or manual tiles.

form.title: Export Controls
form.description: Shared export-power controls. Timed Export and Evening Excess Export use the same kW-to-HR112 calculation pattern, but keep separate power values because manual export and planner export have different purposes.

form.title: Evening Excess Export
form.description: Optional evening sell-off automation carried forward from homebridge-giv-iog-local v3.7.5. Configure the planner here, then use the Evening Excess Export switch in Apple Home to arm or disarm it day to day.

form.title: Octopus Flux Export
form.description: Peak-rate export for Octopus Flux. The Flux tariff peak band is only the eligible selling period; GivHome sells only the spare kWh available after reserve and margin, so a short run inside the band can be correct.

form.title: Octopus Flux Export — advanced
form.description: Observed-power Flux settings. Change the eligible peak period only if you deliberately want a shorter or different selling period. A full 16:00-19:00 band at 6 kW would require about 18 kWh before reserves. CH/AIO planning uses observed/effective discharge rather than assuming HR112 limits the slot.

form.title: Octopus Agile Export
form.description: Agile Export searches any high-value Agile Outgoing half-hour by default. Keep Planner only and dry run on while observing. It is intentionally separate from Flux peak export and is not limited by the hidden custom time fields unless Slot search is set to Custom time window.

form.title: Octopus Agile Export — advanced
form.description: Advanced value, learning, tariff and audit settings. Time limiting is separated below because normal Agile mode should search the whole day.

form.title: Octopus Agile Export — custom time limiter
form.description: Hidden unless Slot search is Custom time window. Normal Agile mode ignores these values completely and searches the whole day for any worthwhile published Agile half-hour.

form.title: HomeKit Controls
form.description: Optional controls shown in Apple Home. GivHome handles local readback, safe command timing and inverter-model safeguards automatically.

description: Configure local GivEnergy monitoring and optional Apple Home controls for GivHome.
